key_insight: Applying an elastic consolidation constraint to test-time training stabilizes inference-time updates for spatial memory, preventing catastrophic forgetting and enabling fast, chunked processing of arbitrarily long 3D sequences in a single pass.
problem_solved: LaCT's fully plastic inference updates overfit and forget when processing long inputs, forcing use of a single large chunk and preventing scalable single-pass handling of very long sequences.
method: Introduce Elastic Test-Time Training: add an elastic (EWC-style) regularizer during inference updates to anchor important weights and reduce forgetting.
Operate on smaller spatial chunks with a fast spatial memory module so the model can incrementally process long sequences while preserving previously learned information.
Use lightweight per-parameter importance estimates and a restricted optimization schedule to keep test-time updates both stable and computationally efficient.
impact: Makes test-time adaptation practical and robust for long-context 3D reconstruction and related tasks, allowing deployed models to adapt on-the-fly without catastrophic forgetting and with low latency.
